items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: And the other interesting person I meet there was also Walter “Gil” Fuller.

ctx.x: I know. It’s like you want those things to have this — like when did music switch back to straight eighth notes. Well the day Chuck Berry — I mean you want this thing to be compartmentalized a little bit.
You do. And the other interesting person I meet there was also Walter “Gil” Fuller.
